gnosh session

  Look at and manage sessions. These start no model.
  Also typed: gnosh sessions or gnosh s.

  None of these commands is built yet in this build of gnosh: typing one stops
  with a message that says so.

Usage
  gnosh session <command> [flags] [arguments]

Commands
  list                    List this project's sessions. (Not built yet.)
  show <id>               Print one session. (Not built yet.)
  last                    Print the most recent session. (Not built yet.)
  rename <id> <title...>  Give a session a new title. (Not built yet.)

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
